notes.title: Welcome to the Playtest
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, dear guest. You're welcome to the Black Lotus Motel Playtest. I'm glad you're here to be part of making a great cooperative escape simulator. [/h3]

[h3]How can you help? [b]There's a lot you can do for the Motel![/b]
[/h3]

[b]- [url=https://discord.gg/HrZww5NMDU]JOIN THE DISCORD[/url]:[/b] Hit me up with a message anywhere on the Discord channel to hang out and join you for a stream of your play-throughs. I will be muted during the gameplay session taking note of any issues that you might notice or not. I will need your permission to record the session that I'll later review and may or may not use in the future for promotional purposes (like in the trailer as seen in the store page). [b]THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT CONTRIBUTION YOU CAN MAKE TO THE GAME, since watching gameplay is a thousand times more accurate for debugging rather than reading text descriptions from players.[/b]

[b]- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1677400]JOIN THE COMMUNITY GROUP[/url]:[/b] It will be awesome to have you among all the rest of the Motel guests to share your thoughts and ideas about the Motel. I'm happy to share this space with you to connect and let you involve in the development of the game. Please feel free to use it as a safe place where we can be in touch for discussions and make the game better each time. I value your feedback! Please avoid comments of hatred or non-constructive feedback.

- Remember to Follow the game to receive new updates as soon as they upload!

[b]MAKE YOUR SPOT WORTH THE WHILE![/b] You are one of a reduced number of players that are having access to the game at this stage. Please make sure you actually "test" the game to help boost its development. I'm waiting for you to reach out!
